name: read_memory
summary: Read up to 512 values of a device's memory from start_address, as a chip's get does: an IC Housing or suit (its chip's stack), Logic Sorter, dish, fabricator, rocket avionics. Read only.

help.text: A Logic Memory has only its Setting, no memory (memory_not_readable). A range past the memory's last address is invalid_argument; the reply gives stack_size. An IC Housing or suit without a chip is no_programmable_chip.

start_address.description: The first address to read, from 0.

count.description: How many values to read, 1 to 512.
